differentiation.extension: Ask what changes if the card is flicked slowly, and why.
differentiation.support: Provide a sentence frame: 'The coin stayed still because...'

student_instructions: Predict, then observe, then explain using inertia.
success_criteria: Student predicts the coin falls into the glass.
Student explains it using resistance to a change in motion.
teacher_instructions: Balance the card on the glass with the coin on top.
Flick the card horizontally and have students predict what happens.
title: Coin and card

differentiation.extension: Introduce a two-force problem requiring a net force first.
differentiation.support: Provide the rearranged formula a = F/m on the sheet.

student_instructions: Solve for a given F and m; state units at every step.
success_criteria: Correct value with correct units on at least three items.
teacher_instructions: Work the first item aloud, then release students to pairs.
title: Computing acceleration
